headline: Central Fronts Stir as Base Lines Shift
war_summary: Since the last edition, Weathered Expanse has seen the sharpest movement: 14 strategic-base events in the latest two hours and 81 across the day. Its present ledger stands at one Warden, two Colonial, and six neutral bases, a marked shift from the earlier four Warden, two Colonial, and three neutral. Mooring County has also changed materially, adding three events in two hours and 42 over 24 hours; all twelve bases are now Warden-held, whereas the previous report listed two Colonial positions. Nevish Line remains a contested sector at six Warden and two Colonial bases, though no event was recorded in the latest two hours and three in six. Callahan’s Passage, formerly active, has gone quiet in the latest two-hour window, with 13 events over the day and all ten bases presently Warden-held. Older turbulence persists in Kuura Strand and Fisherman’s Row, with 18 and 15 daily events respectively, but neither has fresh movement in the last two hours. The heaviest current pressure is concentrated on Weathered Expanse and Mooring County.
